newsitem.title: USA: Dell to cut prices on corporate PC line.
newsitem.headline: Dell to cut prices on corporate PC line.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp said Monday it was reducing prices up to 13 percent in the U.S. on its OptiPlex corporate desktop personal computers, effective immediately.
The company said the price cuts are the third since January on the OptiPlex line and that prices on some OptiPlexes have dropped as much as 44 percent since January.
The company said the price cuts reflect the fact that costs and component prices have been declining.
The company said that more than 90 percent of its revenues are generated from business and government sales, with more than 70 percent coming from large corporations and public institutions.
Dell is a direct-sales computer systems company with revenues of $8.7 billion in the past four quarters.
